clue.text: Down here fast changes are required

definitions.note: soft down is the fluffy plumage of a bird

indicators.note: changes tells us the letters of the two words here fast are reshuffled

explanation.surface: Somewhere a quick alteration is demanded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Down' looks like a direction but is the soft covering of a bird; 'changes' rearranges HERE FAST.
explanation.definitionFit: Down is fine soft plumage, the covering of birds.

clue.text: City investment is about to be productive

indicators.note: is about tells us the investment word wraps round the City letters

parts.note: a fund is a pool of investment money
EC is the postcode of the City of London, the financial district

explanation.surface: Money put into the City is about to pay off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'City' means the City of London, the financial district, whose postcodes begin EC; 'is about' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Fertile and fruitful, yielding plenty.

clue.text: Irritation anyone can cause

indicators.note: cause suggests the letters of anyone can are made into something new

explanation.surface: Anybody is capable of being irritating.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cause' rearranges ANYONECAN.
explanation.definitionFit: Annoyance is a feeling of vexation, another word for irritation.

clue.text: Sharp crooked instruments

indicators.note: crooked suggests the letters of sharp are bent out of order

explanation.surface: Pointed, bent tools.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sharp' looks like a description of the instruments, but it is the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Harps are stringed musical instruments plucked by hand.

clue.text: About one hundred mince pies made from these?

definitions.text: About one hundred mince pies made from these?

parts.note: re means about or concerning
C is the Roman numeral for one hundred

indicators.note: mince suggests the letters of pies are chopped up and rearranged

explanation.surface: A batch of a hundred festive pastries baked from instructions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mince' looks like the pie filling but is the anagram signal, turning PIES into IPES.
explanation.definitionFit: Cooking instructions tell you how to make dishes, such as a batch of pastries.

clue.text: Climbed and peeled off

explanation.surface: Someone went up a wall and then stripped away a layer.
explanation.definitionFit: To scale a cliff is to climb it, and to scale a fish or a surface is to strip flakes from it.

clue.text: Physical energy retained by NCO

indicators.note: retained by shows the energy letter is held inside the officer word

parts.note: a corporal is a non-commissioned officer
E is the symbol for energy in physics

explanation.surface: A drill sergeant type who keeps fit and full of pep.
explanation.walkthrough: NCO is a non-commissioned officer; 'retained by' puts E inside CORPORAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Corporeal means bodily, of the body rather than the spirit.

clue.text: Toboggan race starts with a gu

parts.note: a luge is a small racing toboggan

indicators.note: starts signals the opening letter of race is used

explanation.surface: A sledging contest is begun by firing a starting pistol.
explanation.walkthrough: The Luger is a German semi-automatic pistol; 'starts' gives R from race.
explanation.definitionFit: The Luger is a famous German semi-automatic pistol.

clue.text: Licensed to make flags

indicators.note: to make suggests the letters of licensed are used to build a new word

explanation.surface: Being authorised to manufacture banners.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flags' looks like banners but is the verb meaning weakens or droops.
explanation.definitionFit: To flag is to tire or weaken, as strength declines.

clue.text: Yet it might help a company to expand

definitions.text: Yet it might help a company to expand

parts.words: Yet it might help a company to expand
parts.note: a binding business agreement can win a firm work and growth, though the same word as a verb means to shrink, the reverse of expand

explanation.surface: A paradoxical remark about business growth.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'Yet' points to the paradox: the noun is an agreement that grows a business, the verb means to shrink.
explanation.definitionFit: A signed deal with a client lets a firm take on more work, while the verb means to get smaller.

clue.text: Distressing twitch about to irritate

indicators.note: about tells us the twitch word goes round the irritate word

parts.note: a tic is a nervous twitch
to rag is to tease or irritate

explanation.surface: A nervous twitch that is starting to annoy someone badly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' is the container signal: the twitch goes round the word for irritate.
explanation.definitionFit: Something tragic is deeply sad and upsetting.

clue.text: Soaks up food

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the soaks word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: wets means soaks or drenches

explanation.surface: Someone mops up a meal.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'up' reverses WETS.
explanation.definitionFit: A stew is a dish of meat and vegetables cooked slowly in liquid.

clue.text: English poet gives contradictory answers

parts.note: a flat negative reply to a question
the opposite, positive reply to the same question

explanation.surface: A poet who cannot make up his mind when questioned.
explanation.walkthrough: Alfred Noyes was an English poet, author of The Highwayman.
explanation.definitionFit: Alfred Noyes (1880-1958) was an English writer of verse, best known for The Highwayman.

clue.text: Vessel -right one in which to serve 11

parts.note: a pot is a cooking vessel
to pour drinks is to serve them
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Instructions about the right pot for dishing up a cooked dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 11 refers to the answer at 11-down, STEW; the word in the grid originally meant a stew of mixed meats.
explanation.definitionFit: Originally the term was a Spanish-French dish of mixed meats simmered together, hence a mixture or hotchpotch.

clue.text: Banana-split contains pineapple

indicators.note: contains signals the letters sit inside the run of the hyphenated dessert name

explanation.surface: A banana split dessert that also has some pineapple in it.
explanation.walkthrough: The run sits inside bANANA-Split, ignoring the hyphen.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the French and botanical word for the pineapple fruit.

clue.text: Poorly aunt to recover spontaneously

indicators.note: poorly suggests the letters of aunt are in a bad way and rearranged

parts.note: to rally is to recover strength

explanation.surface: An ailing aunt gets better on her own.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Poorly' looks like a description of the aunt but is the anagram signal, giving NATU.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something without effort or forcing is doing it in a free, unforced way.

clue.text: Wind resulting from unsettled weather

indicators.note: unsettled suggests the letters of weather are disturbed and rearranged

explanation.surface: Gusts caused by a spell of changeable weather.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wind' looks like moving air but is the verb to coil or twine.
explanation.definitionFit: To wreathe is to twist or coil around, as to wind something.

clue.text: Convert may avoid the real issue

explanation.surface: A convert to a cause may dodge awkward questions.
explanation.definitionFit: To persuade someone round to your view, and to discuss a matter without ever reaching its point.

clue.text: Cessation of work means reduction in pay

explanation.surface: Workers walk out because their wages have been cut.
explanation.definitionFit: A strike or halt to work, and a sum deducted from wages.

clue.text: Given medical care at another's expense?

explanation.surface: A patient whose doctor's bill someone else paid.
explanation.definitionFit: A doctor attends a patient, and a host pays for a guest's meal or drink.

clue.text: Condiment makes many unwell

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for five hundred, so many
ill means unwell

explanation.surface: A seasoning that makes lots of people sick.
explanation.walkthrough: Crosswords use a large Roman numeral such as D for 'many'.
explanation.definitionFit: Dill is a herb used as a seasoning, for example in pickles.

clue.text: My call is dealt with smoothly

indicators.note: dealt with suggests the letters of my call are handled and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone says their telephone call was handled without fuss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dealt with' rearranges MYCALL.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting in a composed, unruffled manner is acting without fuss or disturbance.

clue.text: Upset? Depends on how bigheaded one is!

definitions.text: Depends on how bigheaded one is!

explanation.surface: Someone is upset, depending on how conceited they are.
explanation.definitionFit: A boat upset in the water overturns, and the measure of a hat depends on how big your head is.

clue.text: Negotiate a rise?

parts.note: rather than bargaining for higher wages, negotiate means getting over a slope, as a climber does

explanation.surface: An employee asking the boss for higher wages.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Negotiate a rise' suggests pay talks, but it means getting up a hill.
explanation.definitionFit: To go up a slope or climb is to get over that incline.

clue.text: Device preventing leaves from spreading around

definitions.text: Device preventing leaves from spreading around

parts.words: Device preventing leaves from spreading around
parts.note: leaves are sheets of paper rather than foliage, held together by a small bent wire

explanation.surface: A garden gadget that stops fallen leaves blowing everywhere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaves' suggests autumn foliage, but they are sheets of paper.
explanation.definitionFit: A small bent loop of wire grips sheets of stationery together so they stay in order.

clue.text: Born under Victoria, true

indicators.note: under in a down clue puts the born letter below the Victoria word

parts.note: the Victoria is a well-known British variety of plum

explanation.surface: A loyal subject born in the reign of Queen Victoria.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Victoria' suggests the queen but is a common British variety of plum.
explanation.definitionFit: Plumb means exactly vertical, and true in building means straight and level.

clue.text: Helen's favourite city

explanation.surface: A woman named Helen naming the place she likes best.
explanation.walkthrough: In Greek myth the Trojan prince Paris carried Helen off to Troy; he is also the French capital.
explanation.definitionFit: The Trojan prince was Helen of Troy's lover, and the French capital shares his name.

clue.text: You can't do better than master this

definitions.text: You can't do better than master this

parts.words: You can't do better than master this
parts.note: add the word master in front and you get the finest work an artist can make

explanation.surface: Advice that mastering a skill is the best you can do.
explanation.walkthrough: A masterpiece is the best work possible, so 'master' before this word gives the peak.
explanation.definitionFit: A single work or item, which with master in front becomes the very best work.

clue.text: A quail freaks out, seeing eagle

indicators.note: freaks out suggests the letters of a quail go wild and rearrange

explanation.surface: A small game bird panics on spotting a bird of prey.
explanation.walkthrough: Aquila is Latin for eagle and the name of a constellation.
explanation.definitionFit: Latin for the bird of prey, also the constellation named after it.

clue.text: Make delicate adjustments to splendid melody

parts.note: fine means excellent or splendid
a tune is a melody

explanation.surface: A musician polishing a lovely song.
explanation.definitionFit: To adjust precisely by small amounts, as with a radio dial.

clue.text: it will grow more by development

definitions.text: it will grow more by development

indicators.note: development suggests the letters of more by are worked into a new shape

explanation.surface: A remark that something will get bigger as it develops.
explanation.walkthrough: 'development' rearranges MOREBY; the whole clue also describes an unborn creature growing.
explanation.definitionFit: An unborn organism in its earliest stage grows larger as it develops.

clue.text: Have a leader killed

parts.note: a leader is read as one's own head, so to lose it is to be executed by the axe

explanation.surface: An order to assassinate a political chief.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leader' suggests a political chief, but it is the head on one's shoulders.
explanation.definitionFit: Execution by decapitation removes the head, the body's top part.
